market_status.boundary: The clip is user-supplied reference-ad test data. It proves visible creative/gameplay content only; it does not prove chart rank, installs, retention, revenue, or current popularity.

facts: A green humanoid moves over a raised yellow course containing dark maze-like path cells.
Dark path material forms a tall vertical stack associated with the moving character.
The character traverses curved and straight course segments while the stack height visibly changes.
The scene is fully digital 3D imagery.
A cyan humanoid moves among bright pink ring-like pieces on grey platforms.
Collected rings form a vertical stack under or beside the character.
The stack is spent to form a continuous route over a long curved white guide/path between separated platforms.
The game assets are digitally composited over a real outdoor camera background.

inferences.claim: The reusable loop is collect stackable path material, choose/maintain a route, then consume the stack to bridge hazards or gaps.
The visible creative likely juxtaposes two renderings of the same collect-and-spend traversal mechanism rather than proving two numbered production levels.

unknowns: Exact touch controls are not visible.
Exact collision, scoring, failure, restart, ad, retention and economy rules are not proven.
The clip does not prove that its first and second visual sections are literal Level 1 and Level 2.
No direct platform mini-game runtime, package, AppID, DevTools or device evidence is present.

reusable_mechanics: visible stack height as resource feedback
short setup followed by a high-risk traversal payoff
difficulty escalation through route length, split pickups and resource pressure
non_copyable_expression: exact camera, level geometry, colors, typography and values
video frames, audio and source media in shipped content
